about: In Cloudberry Kingdom, the beloved platformer returns — now available on modern consoles. Dive into a world where every jump, jetpack boost, and wheelie roll feels fresh yet comfortingly familiar.

Meet Bob, the courageous hero of Cloudberry Kingdom. When King Kobbler threatens to throw the kingdom into chaos, Bob steps up to protect his home. With the princess in danger and the future of the realm at stake, Bob sets out on a daring adventure to restore peace.
Experience endless platforming challenges with procedurally generated levels that ensure each run feels unique.
Follow Bob’s journey in Story Mode as he confronts King Kobbler and overcomes tough platforming challenges.
Create your own levels and challenge friends to conquer your designs in Free Play Mode.
Test your skills in a range of mini-games and time trials built to push your platforming abilities in Arcade Mode.
Team up with friends in cooperative play or compete in exciting multiplayer challenges.
Personalise Bob with a variety of costumes and accessories.

Cloudberry Kingdom delivers the energetic platforming action fans love, now enhanced with improved resolution for a modern gameplay experience. Get ready to leap back into the adventure and save Cloudberry Kingdom!
